name: gitlab-link
description: Link GitLab merge requests (gitlab.com or self-hosted) to a session and choose which changes wake it.

intervalSeconds.title: Check interval (open MRs)
intervalSeconds.description: Seconds between checks of a linked open MR.

mergedIntervalSeconds.title: Check interval (merged or closed MRs)
mergedIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between checks of a merged or closed MR that is still linked and has no deployed wait.

maxBackoffSeconds.title: Longest retry interval
maxBackoffSeconds.description: While GitLab is unreachable, retries back off from 1 minute up to this many seconds.

outageWakeMinutes.title: Outage wake after (minutes)
outageWakeMinutes.description: Wake the session once per outage after GitLab has been unreachable this long, only while a condition is armed.

deliveryComment.title: Default delivery: new comment
deliveryComment.description: always (wake), quiet (add to your next message) or off. Used for every linked MR unless you change it for a specific one. A one-time wait wakes you whatever this says.

deliveryApproved.title: Default delivery: approved
deliveryApproved.description: always (wake), quiet (add to your next message) or off. Used for every linked MR unless you change it for a specific one. A one-time wait wakes you whatever this says.

deliveryMerged.title: Default delivery: merged
deliveryMerged.description: always (wake), quiet (add to your next message) or off. Used for every linked MR unless you change it for a specific one. A one-time wait wakes you whatever this says.

deliveryClosed.title: Default delivery: closed without merging
deliveryClosed.description: always (wake), quiet (add to your next message) or off. Used for every linked MR unless you change it for a specific one. A one-time wait wakes you whatever this says.

deliveryReopened.title: Default delivery: reopened
deliveryReopened.description: always (wake), quiet (add to your next message) or off. Used for every linked MR unless you change it for a specific one. A one-time wait wakes you whatever this says.

deliveryConflict.title: Default delivery: merge conflict
deliveryConflict.description: always (wake), quiet (add to your next message) or off. Used for every linked MR unless you change it for a specific one. A one-time wait wakes you whatever this says.

deliveryPipelineFailed.title: Default delivery: pipeline failed
deliveryPipelineFailed.description: always (wake), quiet (add to your next message) or off. Used for every linked MR unless you change it for a specific one. A one-time wait wakes you whatever this says.

deliveryPipelineSucceeded.title: Default delivery: pipeline succeeded
deliveryPipelineSucceeded.description: always (wake), quiet (add to your next message) or off. Used for every linked MR unless you change it for a specific one. A one-time wait wakes you whatever this says.

ignoredUsers.title: Ignored users (JSON)
ignoredUsers.description: Whose changes to ignore: {"all": [...], "comment": [...], "approved": [...], "merged": [...], "closed": [...], "reopened": [...]}. @me is glab's user. Used unless a link has its own list.

unlinkWhenDone.title: Unlink after merge or close
unlinkWhenDone.description: Unlink a merged or closed MR once no one-time wait remains. Can be changed for a specific link.

deployTargets.title: Deploy targets (JSON)
deployTargets.description: Per-project deploy targets for the deployed condition: {"group/project": {"name": {"jobs": ["deploy:job"], "branch": "main", "notes": {"deploy:job": "text"}}}}. A target not listed is read as a GitLab environment name.

glabPath.title: glab executable
glabPath.description: Path to glab. Left as glab, the usual install folders are tried too.
